explanation: The public scaffold, authoring guide, diagnostics, generated TypeScript client, bounded query model, development workflow, and boundary checker were sufficient to build and run the unfamiliar Blog/CMS workload without RiffDB adaptation code. The evaluator corrected four compiler-reported source issues through the documented symbolic workflow. The generated client directly observed a durable command result and a fenced page result with verified identities. Minor friction came from learning comma-separated enum syntax through a diagnostic and from the boundary checker exposing only positional roots in its help.
